groups: two equal groups of consecutive unprocessed VP cohorts; selected postings unvisited by both paths and without an active continuation
placement: first quartile versus last quartile of positive postings; swap between groups
held_fixed: non-ID payload multiset within each selected posting
witness IDs and ascending ID traversal
common-prefix committed facts and cursors outside selected postings
mutated: placement of non-ID payloads among unvisited posting slots; complete ID-plus-payload tuples are not invariant
calibration: same family component/joint priors as Table 2, no order-specific retuning
statistic: geometric mean of per-state median completion times over five runs after one warm-up
timing: completion only; state reconstruction excluded; online selection and execution included
aggregation_note: Two 60-state ordering columns; a pair shares its base state. No per-state measurements or confidence intervals inferred from aggregates.
selection_precondition: neither P nor R has visited a selected posting; no active continuation, pending qualification observation, or already-read selected payload is changed
state_selection_condition: two consecutive equal-size cohort groups with postings untouched by both paths; no active continuation for altered postings
